column1: # CM-SUBMODULE-PIN-NOT-DOWNGRADED site table (CON-046 round 11, CON-194; review r10 section 7, §11.4.276(C)/(E)(3)).

# of the hook, as found by `cm_submodule_pin_not_downgraded_sites.py census`. The site lint (Part 1 of the paired mutation
# test) refuses a census site without a row, a row without a census site, an ambiguous anchor, a data row without a
# fixture key in want or without a registered mutant, and an internal row without an existing inventory id.
# Columns (TAB): id (S... gate, H... hook), anchor (a fixed string on exactly one code line), token (the census token),
# nth (the n-th equal token on that line), class (data: sha path ident date num text charset; internal: rc flag mode
# env empty; struct), gen (data: vector keys of the near-miss fixtures, `nc` = no near miss is constructible or the
# site is equivalent, with the reason; internal: inventory ids), mutants (registered mutants / proofs, or -), reason.
